paper_title: Subexponential Parameterized Algorithms for Graphs of Polynomial Growth

context: We have shown a low treewidth pattern covering statement for graphs of polynomial growth 1− 1 1+δ with subexponential term being 2k , where δ is the growth rate of the graph class. An almost tight lower bound shows that, assuming ETH, one should not hope for a better term 1− 1 than 2k δ . 1 Two natural questions arise. The first one is to close the gap between 1+δ and 1δ ; we 1 conjecture that our lower bound is tight, and the term k 1− 1+δ in the running time bound of Theorem 1.2 is only a shortfall of our algorithmic techniques. The second one is to derandomize the algorithms of this work and of [18]. The clustering step is the only step of the algorithm of [18] that we do not know how to derandomize, despite its resemblance to the construction of Bartal’s HSTs [3] that was subsequently derandomized [6].
